## Safety checklist

- [ ] No prompt, personal value, screenshot, UI dump, trace, token, or credential is included.
- [ ] Reusable values are typed placeholders.
- [ ] Interactive actions require confirmation.
- [ ] No destructive or send/payment/security action is introduced.
- [ ] Skill versions and the registry revision were increased where required.
- [ ] `python3 scripts/build_registry.py --check` passes.
